# Boise Remodeling Co

> Design-build remodeling for kitchens, bathrooms, whole-home renovations, and room additions in Boise, Idaho and the Treasure Valley.

## About This Business

Boise Remodeling Co is a locally owned design-build remodeling company serving the Treasure Valley. We handle every phase of your project — design, permitting, and construction — under one roof, so you have a single point of contact from first sketch to final walkthrough.

- Phone: (208) 555-0100
- Email: hello@boiseremodeling.co
- Service area: Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Nampa, Kuna, Star, Middleton (Ada + Canyon County)
- Licensed, bonded, and insured
- Founding-client spots available for early homeowners

## Services Offered

**Kitchen Remodels**: Full kitchen redesigns including custom cabinetry, countertops, island additions, appliance packages, and layout changes.

**Bathroom Remodels**: Master bath, guest bath, and powder room remodels including tile work, vanities, walk-in showers, soaking tubs, and heated floors.

**Whole-Home Remodels**: Complete interior renovations covering multiple rooms, open-concept conversions, flooring, lighting, and finish upgrades throughout.

**Room Additions**: Attached additions, in-law suites, sunrooms, and bonus rooms — designed to match your existing home's architecture.

**Basement Finishes**: Converting unfinished basements into livable space: home offices, media rooms, guest suites, and wet bars.

**Outdoor Living**: Covered patios, decks, outdoor kitchens, and pergolas designed for Idaho's four-season lifestyle.
